Card Q&A.a: Because your opponent's Digimon was the target of the battle and is no longer in play, a battle doesn't occur. However, the counter timing and end of attack timing still exist, therefore any applicable effects will trigger.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon without digivolution cards, and this card's [Your Turn] effect deletes that Digimon, what happens to the attack?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[Your Turn] When this Digimon attacks an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, delete that Digimon.
